# Patrick Mockridge

> Independent protocol engineer working on privacy protocols, consensus systems, formal verification, and numerical provenance. The method is to specify the failure mode before the architecture, prove what can be proved, contain what cannot, and record provenance with every result.

- [CV (PDF)](https://patrickmockridge.github.io/cv.pdf): one-page PDF.

- [Substack](https://technologytruth.substack.com/): research and writing.
- [Contact](mailto:patrickmockridge@gmail.com): protocol review, rescue, verification, advisory.

## Selected work

- [DarkWow](https://patrickmockridge.github.io/darkwow/): a private bearer-note system: the note is the asset, possession is authority, and no protocol-level administrator can freeze or confiscate it. The fork-original contract set includes ZK Box and Purse, a ZK-based Identity/Oracle/Attestation/Stablecoin suite, an object-capability bridge, and a no-freeze Promissory Note (the issuer is the note's counterparty for redemption; credential issuers and relayers are explicit counterparties). Object-capability governance, Uncle Merkle consensus, a per-block Pedersen mass balance over native-token calls, and a Lean 4 proof-status ledger. The fork's Lean 4 gadget-level proofs cover `less_than_or_equal`, `base_div`, and `is_not_equal`; the current contracts use `less_than_or_equal` and a quotient-remainder pattern. Research prototype; mainnet TBD; no third-party audit; Lean-modelled opcodes and gadgets are partial; the gate checks instance derivation for 167 contract circuits (179 walked); it does not prove circuit correctness; six assumptions remain; OBL-Z12 is partly open, and OBL-Z17/OBL-C21/OBL-C231 are open or partly open.
- [rnode-rust](https://patrickmockridge.github.io/rnode-rust/): a Rust node for the rho-calculus, ported from the preserved RChain Scala reference. Native object capabilities, horizontal scale-out by design, and a law register tied to the node by conformance corpora. Pre-release; pre-testnet with a community testnet; 72 of 77 laws proved; 19 laws (23 entries) tied to the node; no external audit firm.
- [Azoth](https://patrickmockridge.github.io/azoth/): chemical-engineering calculations in Python and Rust, written twice by hand from one TOML declaration, where every result carries its provenance and unsupported answers are refused. v0.1.1; not on PyPI; not for design work yet.
- [Mudra](https://patrickmockridge.github.io/mudra/): a proof-of-trace system for spreadsheets and small programs. A constant-size Halo2 proof binds a program digest, input/output hashes, return value, and step count. It does not constrain each instruction; per-instruction correctness relies on deterministic replay with the witness. Research build.

## Research

- [Research and writing](https://patrickmockridge.github.io/research/): the Romeo-Juliet critical risk-analysis framework for coordinated systems under information asymmetry — AI, blockchains, politics, business, engineering; UNISS/Ingenesist simulations of influence, secrecy, and layered compromise; an NFL Big Data Bowl 2027 analysis of the Combine pressure signal and the playing-time allocation gap; the Ingenesist archive.
- [NFL Big Data Bowl 2027](https://github.com/PatrickMockridge/nfl-big-data-bowl-2027): an RJF extension to the 2023-2025 NFL draft classes. The 10 Hz Combine burst predicts interior pressure (+0.354 SD/SD) and sacks (+0.317), while the 40-yard dash and 10-yard split do not carry the pressure signal; the cap pays for performance (+0.328 log points per SD), but playing time follows prior snaps and draft capital, not performance. The preregistered RJF transition-zone test is a wide null reported as fallback evidence.
- [Ingenesist archive](https://app.ardrive.io/#/drives/57a3e07f-7adb-4bcf-b013-154869c56e33?name=Ingenesist+Project): Dan Roble's presentations and papers.
